SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_sn AS productSn, p.product_name AS productName, ps.sku_id AS productSkuId, p.product_unit AS productUnit, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, p.cost_price AS productCost, CASE WHEN ps.sku_id IS NOT NULL THEN ps.sku_stock ELSE p.product_stock END AS currentProductStock FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.product_id = p.product_id INNER JOIN store_product sp ON sp.product_id = p.product_id AND sp.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.targetShopId} AND sp.is_delete = 0 WHERE p.shop_id = 0 AND p.is_delete = 0 AND p.vendor_id IS NULL AND p.product_type = 1
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') OR ps.sku_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY p.add_time DESC

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_sn AS productSn, p.product_name AS productName, sps.product_sku_id AS productSkuId, p.product_unit AS productUnit, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, CASE WHEN sps.sku_stock IS NOT NULL THEN sps.sku_stock ELSE sp.product_stock END AS currentProductStock FROM store_product sp LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sp.product_id LEFT JOIN store_product_sku sps ON sps.store_product_id = sp.store_product_id LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.sku_id = sps.product_sku_id WHERE sp.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.shopId} AND sp.is_delete = 0 AND p.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p.is_delete = 0 AND p.product_type = 1
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') OR ps.sku_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY sp.add_time DESC

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_sn AS productSn, p.product_name AS productName, sps_source.product_sku_id AS productSkuId, p.product_unit AS productUnit, p.pic_thumb AS productPicThumb, ps.sku_value AS productSkuName, CASE WHEN sps_source.sku_stock IS NOT NULL THEN sps_source.sku_stock ELSE sp_source.product_stock END AS currentProductStock FROM store_product sp_source INNER JOIN store_product sp_target ON sp_source.product_id = sp_target.product_id AND sp_target.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.targetShopId} AND sp_target.is_delete = 0 LEFT JOIN product p ON p.product_id = sp_source.product_id LEFT JOIN store_product_sku sps_source ON sps_source.store_product_id = sp_source.store_product_id LEFT JOIN product_sku ps ON ps.sku_id = sps_source.product_sku_id WHERE sp_source.shop_id = #{productStockDTO.shopId} AND sp_source.is_delete = 0 AND p.product_id IS NOT NULL AND p.is_delete = 0 AND p.product_type = 1
AND (p.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%') OR ps.sku_value LIKE CONCAT('%',#{productStockDTO.keyword},'%'))
ORDER BY sp_source.add_time DESC
